title: Format Numbers (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Format Numbers applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Format Numbers (BtnFormatNumbers) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Format Numbers normalizes detected numbers for the configured separators, grouping and currency placement
scenarios.expected: oPenEfficiency.Core.Tests drives NumberTextFormatter.TryFormatToken for Format Numbers: detected numbers are re-formatted for the configured thousand and decimal separators (including a space thousand separator), Indian grouping is rendered for large values, and a detected currency is removed, prefixed or suffixed with the documented separator and spacing rules, across the parameter matrix of the production test.

scenarios.title: Format Numbers keeps the in-place currency contract and leaves invalid tokens untouched
scenarios.expected: oPenEfficiency.Core.Tests drives NumberTextFormatter.TryFormatToken for Format Numbers: with in-place currency placement the decimal separator is replaced by the currency symbol in the formatted number, while a token that is not a number makes the formatter report failure and return that token unchanged.
